name: Iris Ringed
author: E. T. Carter
description: A banded iris filling the frame: the radial fibers are crossed by glowing concentric annular rings that ripple slowly outward from a dark pupil, the way a real iris is scored by furrows and a collarette. Fibers give the fine radial grain, the rings a travelling annular lattice that catches a brighter tint where it crosses a fiber; colour blends through the palette by angle, the pupil a dark protagonist with a luminous rim.

params.label: Fibers
params.effect: Number of radial fibers giving the fine grain; higher reads as silken, lower as distinct spokes under the rings.

params.label: Rings
params.effect: Number of concentric annular bands across the field; fewer gives bold widely-spaced rings, more a fine ripple lattice.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Speed and direction the rings travel; positive ripples outward, negative inward, 0 holds them as still bands.

params.label: Pupil size
params.effect: Radius of the dark central pupil the fibers and rings radiate from.
